messages:
lucy: thinking about adding a TTL on checkpoint "stub" objects (soft tombstone) so that we can keep lightweight metadata for recently-evicted shards for ~5m and allow quick rehydration instead of a full manifest fetch :thinking:
omar: hmm, the invariant we need to preserve is that prefix KV cache entries can't point at non-resident tensors. if stub exists but tensors gone, rehydrate must either atomically replace or invalidate prefixes :eyes:
jia: fwiw we did something similar in a POC — we encode a handoff token on the stub that the loader redeems. if token mismatch, loader falls back to full manifest and stats are emitted. works well with concurrent rehydrate attempts :+1:
kevin: two failure modes i worry about:
- stub TTL expires while requests still hold stale KV pointers -> NPE on read
- racing rehydrate where two replicas both try to materialize same shard and OOM one GPU
We solved with lightweight lease + single-writer token in the POC (lease renewal on hot prefixes), maybe reuse that here
lucy: good notes. lease + token sounds right. any opinions on TTL duration? leaning 300s default but tunable per-catalog entry
omar: 300s feels fine for short bursts. for steady-state hot shards it'd be better to rely on lease renewals (so TTL is only for cold eviction grace). can we make heuristics: if prefix hit rate > X keep renewing automatically
jia: yes, add a small budgeted renew path. also add a compat flag: `eager_hydrate_prefix: true|false` so legacy runtimes don't rely on implicit handoff
warmup-bot: config-suggestion: ```
stub_ttl_seconds: 300
stub_lease_seconds: 30
stub_lease_renew_threshold: 0.4  # renew when 40% of lease used
handoff_retry: 3
eager_hydrate_prefix: false
```
kevin: also add metrics: `stub.evictions`, `stub.rehydrates`, `stub.rehydrate_failures`, and a `rehydrate_latency_ms` histogram. we need tracing tags for token id and origin node
lucy: logging example for debugging races: ```
[loader] 2026-03-21T12:33:20Z INFO redeeming handoff token=tok-1234 shard=shard_456 -> start hydration
[loader] 2026-03-21T12:33:20Z WARN lease-conflict shard=shard_456 holder=node-a attempt=node-b
[loader] 2026-03-21T12:33:21Z INFO hydration-complete shard=shard_456 size=120MB
```
omar: minor nit: ensure token is content-addressed (HMAC over manifest+epoch) so it can't be spoofed after a checkpoint swap. that preserves safety across rollouts
jia: and record `stub.origin_manifest_id` in the stub so we can gate rehydrate if manifest history diverged
kevin: operational concern: if stubs accumulate (e.g., bug leaves many stubs) we should have a background scrubber that promotes very-old stubs to tombstone and purges metadata to avoid catalog explosion
lucy: agreed. action items: i'll draft RFC with the lease/token API + config knobs and perf sim. can someone volunteer to add the metrics + log hooks?
omar: i'll add metrics + histogram, pinging infra for tracing tags
jia: i'll sketch the token format and compat flag UX
kevin: i'll implement the scrubber probe and simulate races locally
lucy: thanks all — i'll post the RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
